title: Stop the cacheable /api/status index setting a first-touch cookie

verify.note: The proxy matcher must skip /api/status (so it sets no fq_attr cookie) and still run on other /api paths.

detail: The public-surface probe saw `Set-Cookie: fq_attr=...` (landing /api/status) on the force-static, s-maxage=3600 status index. Same defect HYG-048 fixed for crawler files. /api/status is excluded in the proxy matcher; ipapi.co in the CSP is intentional (lib/geolocation.ts, disclosed on /privacy) and left alone. Also fixes the public-surface spec, which wrongly expected maplibre-gl-shared.mjs to be non-empty: maplibre ships it as 0 bytes.
